sources.entry: Unfoldly - Local-first AI file search for macOS that indexes selected personal files on-device with embeddings, visual search, and local GGUF models.

summary.one_liner: Unfoldly is a local-first macOS app that indexes selected personal files on-device so you can search them by meaning, including images and video moments, and ask follow-up questions about the results.
summary.what_it_does: Users pick folders or files to index, and Unfoldly extracts text, visual signals, metadata, transcripts, and embeddings depending on file type. Searches are described in natural language (for example, finding images of a dog or a video where a demo was presented) rather than by exact filename. Matching files can be opened, and follow-up questions such as summarizing a document or asking about a video or audio file are answered in the context of the source. The README says indexes, models, preferences, chat history, and logs stay in the local app data directory, and that personal file contents are not uploaded. Retrieval uses ChromaDB with BGE-family embedding and reranking models, and models run as local GGUF files through llama.cpp / llama-cpp-python. The uninstall script shows and removes local app data without deleting the original source files.
use_cases: find a file when you only remember its contents
search photos and screenshots by what is in them
locate a video moment by description
ask questions about PDFs and documents on your computer
search meeting audio recordings by topic
chat with a folder of local files privately
notable: Semantic search over personal files with visual search for images, screenshots, and video moments
Runs locally with no account required; the README says file contents are not uploaded
Only indexes folders and files the user selects
Packaged app embeds the Python backend in Tauri, so no separate local HTTP server is needed in normal use
Uninstall helper with a --show preview mode and a confirmation prompt before deletion
caveats: Early beta and macOS-only; the public build is a signed, notarized macOS app
Support quality varies by file structure, size, parser availability, and selected model
Model downloads and app release downloads require internet access
